SELECT ctyname, stname, try_cast(median_age_tot AS double) AS median_age FROM govblock_census.popest_cc_est_agesex WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '7' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the systematic IUPAC name for fentanyl?
SELECT c1 AS iupac_name FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_iupac WHERE c0 = '3345'
Which unified school districts cover the most land?
SELECT name, usps AS state, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_unsd GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many fatal crashes in 2022 happened at railroad crossings?
SELECT count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND rail NOT IN ('0000000', '9999999', '')
Which states have the most active FDIC-insured banks?
SELECT stalp, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE active = '1' AND stalp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many listed drug products are eye medicines?
SELECT count(*) AS products FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_ndc WHERE upper(route) LIKE '%OPHTHALMIC%'
Which hours of 2022 had the highest real-time power price in New York City?
Nyiso Lmp Real Time Hourly Rtlbmp Zone

SELECT time_stamp, try_cast(lbmp_mwhr AS double) AS dollars_per_mwh FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_lmp_real_time_hourly_rtlbmp_zone WHERE name LIKE 'N.Y.C%' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2022' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How much more does a 64-year-old pay than a 21-year-old for marketplace coverage, on average, in 2021?
SELECT age, round(avg(try_cast(individualrate AS double)), 2) AS avg_premium FROM govblock_health.marketplace_rate_puf WHERE businessyear = '2021' AND age IN ('21', '64') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states fill the most antibiotic prescriptions under Medicare Part D?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Geography And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_geo_desc AS state, sum(try_cast(tot_clms AS double)) AS antibiotic_claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_geo_lvl = 'State' AND antbtc_drug_flag = 'Y' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did the Vaccine Injury Compensation Trust Fund pay out in fiscal 2023?
Vaccine Injury Compensation Trust Fund Results
SELECT max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS outlays FROM govblock_treasury.vaccine_injury_compensation_trust_fund_results WHERE fiscal_year = '2023' AND account_desc = 'Outlays'
Which companies drilled the most wells on the outer continental shelf?
Hifld Ocs Oil And Natural Gas Wells
SELECT replace(operator, '"', ''), count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_ocs_oil_and_natural_gas_wells WHERE replace(operator, '"', '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which sections of California law were amended most recently?
SELECT citation, try_cast(last_amended_year AS integer) AS last_amended FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'ca' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Which granted patents contain the most extracted chemical reactions?
SELECT patentnumber, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants WHERE patentnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people do active community water systems in New York serve?

SELECT sum(try_cast(population_served_count AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS' AND primacy_agency_code = 'NY'
Which cities of 100,000 or more have lost the most residents since 2020?

SELECT name, stname, try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) - try_cast(estimatesbase2020 AS double) AS change FROM govblock_census.popest_sub_est WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '162' AND try_cast(estimatesbase2020 AS double) >= 100000 ORDER BY 3 ASC LIMIT 10
How much electricity came from wood and wood waste in 2023?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.GEN.WWW-US-99.A' AND period = '2023'
Which arXiv categories appear on the most papers, cross-listings included?
SELECT category, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_categories GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many approved drugs can be taken by mouth?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE max_phase = 4 AND oral = 1
Which publishers appear most often among Zenodo research records?
SELECT publisher, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_scholarly.zenodo_records GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has the producer price index for all commodities moved year by year?
SELECT year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_wp_data WHERE series_id = 'WPU00000000' AND period = 'M13' ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 10
Which states have the largest number of public schools?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE school_year = '2023-2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubMed papers are indexed under hemoglobins?
SELECT count(DISTINCT pmid) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_mesh WHERE descriptor_name = 'Hemoglobins'
Congressional campaigns in which states spent the most in 2010?
SELECT can_off_sta, sum(try_cast(dis_amo AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.candidate_disbursement WHERE ele_yea = '2010' AND can_off_sta IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How long does a recorded oral argument last on average, in minutes?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(duration AS double)) / 60, 1) AS minutes FROM govblock_courts.oral_arguments
Which fields of study award the most bachelor's degrees?
Scorecard Most Recent Field Of Study
SELECT cipdesc, sum(try_cast(ipedscount2 AS double)) AS degrees FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_field_of_study WHERE credlev = '3' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average return on assets across FDIC-insured banks at the end of 2023?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(roa AS double)), 2) AS average_roa FROM govblock_finance.fdic_financials WHERE cast(repdte AS varchar) = '20231231'
Which counties outside Washington, D.C. send the most workers into the District?

SELECT substr(h_geocode, 1, 5) AS home_county, sum(s000) AS workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_od WHERE state = 'dc' AND part = 'aux' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2019 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What has a gallon of regular gasoline cost each June over the last ten years?
SELECT year, value AS dollars_per_gallon FROM govblock_labor.bls_ap_data WHERE series_id = 'APU000074714' AND period = 'M06' ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 10
Which vehicle components draw the most defect investigations?
SELECT c5 AS component, count(DISTINCT c1) AS investigations FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_investigations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many mortgage applications were turned down in New York in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS denied FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND state_code = 'NY' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '3'
Which New York City agencies publish the most forms in the collection?
SELECT agency, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_reference.forms WHERE gov = 'NYC' AND agency IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many IC50 measurements does ChEMBL hold?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_activities WHERE standard_type = 'IC50'
Which states have the most onshore wind capacity?

SELECT state, round(sum(mw)) AS wind_mw FROM (SELECT state, plant_code, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE technology = 'Onshore Wind Turbine' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many political action committees are based in Washington, D.C.?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees WHERE cmte_st = 'DC'
Which kinds of relationship connect one Rhea reaction to another?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea_relationships WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many upheld complaints against auto insurers did New York record for 2023?
New York Auto Insurer Complaint Rankings
SELECT sum(try_cast(upheld_complaints AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_insurance_filings.ny_auto_insurer_complaint_rankings WHERE filing_year = '2023'
Which states have the most hospices listed on Care Compare?
SELECT state, count(DISTINCT cms_certification_number_ccn) AS hospices FROM govblock_health.cc_hospice_provider WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT definition FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_compounds WHERE name = 'caffeine'
What are the most-cited papers in high-energy physics?
SELECT title, try_cast(citation_count AS integer) AS citations FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_literature ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What did households in New York pay per kilowatt-hour of electricity on average in 2024?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.PRICE.NY-RES.A' AND period = '2024'
Which kinds of Treasury securities carried the highest average interest rate in September 2025?
SELECT security_desc, try_cast(avg_interest_rate_amt AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_treasury.avg_interest_rates WHERE record_date = '2025-09-30' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many companies on EDGAR have had their registration revoked?
SELECT count(*) AS revoked FROM govblock_sec.submissions_companies WHERE flags LIKE '%REVOKED%'
Which companies were sitting on the most cash at the end of fiscal 2021?

SELECT s.name, max(n.value) AS cash FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_num n JOIN govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub s ON s.adsh = n.adsh WHERE n.tag = 'CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue' AND cast(n.qtrs AS varchar) = '0' AND s.form = '10-K' AND cast(s.fy AS varchar) = '2021' AND n.uom = 'USD' AND (n.segments IS NULL OR n.segments = '') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many 13F holdings reports were filed for the quarter ending December 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_submission WHERE submissiontype = '13F-HR' AND periodofreport = '31-DEC-2024'
Which hospitals collect the most completed patient surveys?
SELECT facility_name, max(try_cast(number_of_completed_surveys AS double)) AS surveys FROM govblock_health.cc_hcahps_hospital WHERE facility_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many health-based drinking water violations began in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement WHERE is_health_based_ind = 'Y' AND substr(non_compl_per_begin_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Within Health and Human Services, which agencies are credited on the most patent applications?

SELECT level_two AS agency, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_gov_interest_org WHERE level_one = 'Department of Health and Human Services' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many FDIC-insured institutions have closed or merged out of existence?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE active = '0'
Which kinds of emission sources account for the most reported greenhouse gases in 2023?

SELECT s.subpart_category, sum(try_cast(e.co2e_emission AS double)) AS co2e_tons FROM govblock_environment.ghg_facts_subp_ghg_emission AS e JOIN govblock_environment.ghg_dim_subpart AS s ON try_cast(s.subpart_id AS double) = try_cast(e.sub_part_id AS double) WHERE e.year = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the title of patent US-5153197-A?
SELECT patent_number, title, publication_date FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents WHERE patent_number = 'US-5153197-A'
Which states have the largest share of veterans among adults?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B21001_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B21001_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_veterans FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b21001' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
